question: Which additional exact item-specific and common reductions occur inside BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup after its accepted signed factor multiplication?

scope.boundary: This packet follows the remainder of one exact cost helper and records reduction gates and arithmetic. It does not establish the meanings or writers of the neutral globals, caller-side cost parity, validity of uninitialized record IDs, production completion, or runtime execution of these branches.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted building IDs 101, 105, 114 and UEA 18, 19, 20, 24 reduction branches.
Binds item IDs 111, 112, and 116 to exact Cathedral, University, and Factory records without assigning text as effect execution.
Defines cumulative-mode ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup and the retail UEA table; ID 21 has no entry in that table.
Provides the bounded player-mask classifier role of 0x82CD5A70 without proving this cost branch at runtime.

acceptedInputs.building: For item IDs 100 through 199, signed record byte +0x41 is multiplied by the current scalar and joins the common reduction path.
acceptedInputs.wonder: For item IDs 200 through 299, signed record halfword +0x40 is multiplied by the current scalar and joins the common reduction path.
acceptedInputs.scalar: The helper starts its scalar at ten and subtracts a positive signed player-indexed halfword from 0x830E9050 before either record-factor multiplication.
acceptedInputs.qualification: The address ranges are cost-helper routing ranges, not validated initialized-definition domains. Multiplication and later shifts use guest 32-bit arithmetic.

additionalBuildingBranches.name: Cathedral
additionalBuildingBranches.gate: At 0x82CF13C0 the item-minus-100 mask selects the branch; 0x82CF13D0 requests cumulative UEA ID 21 for the current player.
additionalBuildingBranches.result: A nonzero lookup result subtracts signed cost divided by two with truncation toward zero at 0x82CF13E4 through 0x82CF13EC.
additionalBuildingBranches.retailQualification: The supported image's 16-by-4 retail UEA table contains no ID 21, so this static branch has no accepted retail activation or runtime observation.

additionalBuildingBranches.name: University
additionalBuildingBranches.gate: At 0x82CF13F8 the item mask matches; word 0x830EDC34 must differ from -1 and a halfword selected by that word from 0x830E9070 must equal the halfword selected by the current signed player byte from the same base.
additionalBuildingBranches.result: The matching gate subtracts signed cost divided by two with truncation toward zero at 0x82CF1434 through 0x82CF143C.
additionalBuildingBranches.qualification: The global word, halfword array, and policy meaning are neutral; no University gameplay effect or runtime activation is inferred.

additionalBuildingBranches.name: Factory
additionalBuildingBranches.gate: At 0x82CF1444 the item mask matches; word 0x830EDC08 must differ from -1 and its selected halfword from 0x830E9070 must equal the current-player-selected halfword.
additionalBuildingBranches.result: The matching gate subtracts signed cost divided by three with truncation toward zero at 0x82CF1478 through 0x82CF1480.
additionalBuildingBranches.qualification: The global word, halfword array, and policy meaning are neutral; no Factory gameplay effect or runtime activation is inferred.

additionalCommonBranches.gate: Unsigned halfword at 0x830E8FFE is nonzero and the item mask equals 0x00000020 or 0x00001000 at 0x82CF148C through 0x82CF14A4.
additionalCommonBranches.result: Subtract signed truncation-toward-zero of three times the current cost divided by four at 0x82CF14A8 through 0x82CF14B8.
additionalCommonBranches.qualification: The halfword's meaning and writer are unresolved. This applies after prior applicable item-specific reductions, not directly to the base factor.

additionalCommonBranches.gate: The native wonder branch subtracts signed cost divided by two at 0x82CF14CC through 0x82CF14E4, then cumulative UEA 24 can subtract a further signed half at 0x82CF14E8 through 0x82CF14FC.
additionalCommonBranches.result: The first half is unconditional within the helper's wonder range; the second requires a nonzero lookup result.
additionalCommonBranches.qualification: Only item IDs 200 through 236 have accepted initialized wonder records. The helper range does not validate the other IDs.

additionalCommonBranches.gate: After the UEA 24 test, the low byte of 0x82CD5A70(current player) is zero and word 0x82FFE7C8 is greater than two at 0x82CF1500 through 0x82CF1528.
additionalCommonBranches.result: The shared final branch subtracts signed cost divided by two with truncation toward zero at 0x82CF1540 through 0x82CF1548.
additionalCommonBranches.qualification: The classifier has a bounded human-mask role elsewhere, but this exact cost branch and the global word's policy meaning have no runtime observation.

additionalCommonBranches.gate: City halfword +0x3C has bit 0x0008 set at 0x82CF152C through 0x82CF153C.
additionalCommonBranches.result: The same shared final branch subtracts signed cost divided by two with truncation toward zero at 0x82CF1540 through 0x82CF1548.
additionalCommonBranches.qualification: The field's producer and policy meaning are unresolved.

currentEvidence.method: One exact-function generated-code window identified the remaining branch conditions and arithmetic; one foreground read-only Ghidra raw-word query covered the two adjoining late-function windows. Previously accepted packets supply the earlier item factors and UEA branches.

entries.result: Exact guest words corroborate item masks, UEA ID 21 call, two neutral word-and-halfword equality gates, and the half and third reductions.
Exact guest words corroborate the neutral halfword gate for Library and University, native wonder half, UEA 24 test, classifier/global gate, city flag gate, and shared final half reduction.

currentEvidence.qualification: Ghidra's configured function listing truncates after the save-register thunk, so current-image raw words, not its decompilation, support the interior addresses. Generated code is exact-function corroboration only. No runtime probe was performed.

guards: Do not treat UEA 21 as a retail active bonus or assign it a player-facing name from this dormant branch.
Do not name neutral global words, halfword array, or city +0x3C bit without separate producer and consumer evidence.
Do not apply percentage reductions to original factors when the branch acts on the already modified cost.
Do not treat the helper's ID ranges as initialized-definition validation or claim every caller uses identical final cost.
Do not infer gameplay-effect execution, UI parity, AI parity, production completion, or runtime behavior from cost arithmetic.
conclusion: Beyond the accepted Barracks, Library, Courthouse, and UEA 24 branches, the exact cost helper contains a Cathedral UEA-21 half reduction, neutral-gated University half and Factory one-third reductions, a neutral-gated Library/University three-quarter reduction, and separate final half reductions for the wonder and building paths. The formula is static and sequential; activation, global meanings, valid-ID enforcement, and runtime parity remain unresolved.
